correctness.rationale: Uniform integral proof: hypergraph-independent subsets are exactly supports meeting at most k antipodal pairs; an equivariant support projection and nonequivariant contiguous section identify its homology with the simplex skeleton; exterior chains give wedge^k ker(sum) integrally; signed complementary-face duality yields ambient orientation twist eta and integral dual; a mod-p fixed-space argument proves weight-versus-root nonisomorphism. Exhaustive signed Lefschetz checks over all B_n elements in seven small (n,k) cases and modular fixed-space checks for n=3..10 agree, without replacing the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The canonical regular cross-polytope family has full signed permutation symmetry and its nonequivariant theta homotopy was known. The theorem computes the integral action uniformly for every permitted face dimension and isolates a weight-versus-root lattice difference invisible to rational characters and wedge counts, with an explicit modular diagnostic for every n>=3 at k=1. This supplies natural structural integral data, not a selected small numerical parameter.
